title: 第六章 袭击
content_zh:
看着燃起的篝火，许元微微一叹，又轻笑一声。
曾经沧源剧情不管再怎么繁杂也终究只是一款游戏，不可能将一个完整世界的方方面面全都展现出来。
在这拥有超凡的世界，曾经的很多常识都会变成他人的笑柄。
这里生病了不一定需要吃药，野外失温了也不一定需要篝火取暖。
许元自认为是一个适应力很强的人，但面对这种世界规则性的转变，二十余年养成的习惯暂时还是会影响他的思维模式。
思维发散，许元瞥了一眼洞口的巨蟒。
这巨蟒从他醒来后就一直趴在那里盯着他，就好像认识他这张脸一样。
没有深思，虽然2.5D像素风转第一人称真实视角让对方的变化很大，但许元依旧大概猜出了眼前这头巨蟒是什么品种。
焱灵蟒。
一类较为稀缺精英火属性材料怪，有一定灵智，可以收服成宝宝，后续培养成焱灵蛟。
当初在游戏里，收服这种巨蟒很简单，打服就行，一种极为好Yin怕死的妖兽。
许元在游戏中看不上这种下三滥的玩意做宝宝，但对方产的焱灵液倒是个好东西，将其做为辅药炼制的一些丹药即便到了大后期也有用。
目前他没办法炼丹，不过焱灵液却是是一种可以直接使用的天材地宝。
略微回忆公式书上对于焱灵液的描写，许元眼神微微闪烁。
易经伐髓、拔除寒疾、滋阴壮阳。蛇性本Yin，附带略微的催|情之效.....
想到这，许元忽然记起，这玩意好像也是走邪道世界线中的至宝合欢散的配方之一。
垂眸看了一眼手里的水囊袋，下意识往洞内另一人那边看了一眼。
冉青墨做完刚才的一切后，直接默默的在山洞的另一侧盘腿坐下开始闭目养神，冷淡的气息隔着老远就能感受到。
许元收回了视线，默默将水囊放了下去。
焱灵液好东西确实是好东西，不过目前这状况得少喝，不然被那大冰坨子剁了他都没地方哭。

想着这些乱七八糟的事情，许元拍了拍身上湿润的锦绣华袍，起身准备去让洞口那只巨蟒帮他烘干。
衣服湿了不用烤火便能迅速烘干，某种意义上来说，比前世那些烘干机都还要方便百倍。
许元缓步走动的声音并没有引起冉青墨的注意，她依旧安静的坐着闭目养神。
来到近前，对上焱灵蟒那双巨大的竖瞳，许元发现自己在某些方面的适应能力真的蛮强。
一人一蛇对视间，许元抬手指了指自己的衣服。
焱灵蟒只是趴在那里静静的盯着他，没动。
许元深吸一口气，指了指旁边冉青墨。
焱灵蟒竖瞳中流露出一丝人性化的鄙夷，然后很从心的张开嘴巴将蛇信嘴中伸了出来。
蛇信一出，一股干燥灼热的感觉立刻铺面而来，华袍上的水汽以肉眼可见额速度蒸发。
许元哑然，看起来这些妖兽也吃狐假虎威这一套。
焱灵蟒的烘干速度很快，但就在许元身上华袍即将彻底被烘干之时，
变故陡然发生！
原本温顺畏缩的焱灵蟒那双巨大的竖瞳中忽然闪过一丝疯狂的杀意，吐出的蛇信忽然化为了一道残影夹杂着铺面的热浪朝着许元的脑袋打来！！
这种庞然巨物的攻击一旦打中，许元脑袋炸开是根本没有商量的余地。
这一次，许元看到了，但普通人身体根本没法躲开这种速度的袭击。
死亡的气息如潮水般将他包裹，他只能看着那蛇信如同铁锤般带着
劲风朝他脑袋砸来。
生死时刻，一道蓝色剑光突兀的划破空间，弥漫开来的热浪瞬间被绵延不绝的冰寒所吞噬。
眼前一花，那道黑色倩影以肉眼不可见的速度已然挡在了他的身前。
“啪嗒——”

一声脆响，那细长厚重的蛇信被斩断掉在了冰冷的地面上，残存的神经让这段蛇信在地上不断扭动。
山洞内安静了一瞬，
“嘶啊！！！！”jj.br>
一声尖锐的痛苦嘶鸣，焱灵蟒庞大的身躯开始不断的挣扎，山洞都被其震得发颤。
挡在许元身前的冉青墨一双清幽眸子平淡的盯着面前的巨蟒，轻轻将手按在了剑柄之上，随意的出剑一挥。
无声间，一道贯穿整个山洞的斩横便出现在了洞口的内壁之上，透过这道斩痕，外面的阴沉的雨天清晰可见。
而洞口那原本不断挣扎的焱灵蟒也随之忽然僵住。
冉青墨归剑入鞘，缓缓转身看向许元：
“有人想杀你，我们得走了。”
没有责怪，没有质问，突兀的话语只是在称述一个她发现的事实。
随着女子清淡的声线，其身后的焱灵蟒的头颅被斜斩一份唯二，悄然的滑落......
“........”
许元看着眼前这一幕，用力的咬了咬嘴唇。
不用冉青墨提醒，他也已经意识到这是有人想要让他死在这深山之中。
焱灵蟒这种妖兽灵智不低，生性好Yin怕死，能多苟活一瞬，绝不会冒死反噬，但这只焱灵蟒方才却在冉青墨在场的情况下想要冒死杀他。
只能是有什么发自内心恐惧的东西让它必须这么做。
他忽然有些后怕。
若是方才冉青墨出去捡柴火的时候，他冒然进入这焱灵蟒的攻击范围，可能等她回来，自己已然变成了一具尸体。
《沧源》的剧情中许家三公子一共有九条线死在了被冉青墨绑架的路上，每种死法不一。
因为冉青墨的常识缺失和疏忽，失温而死仅仅只是其中一条。

在不到半米深的小溪中喝水时被淹死、坠崖而死、脑袋被一木棍敲死......
三公子在各个时间线的各种倒霉的死法经常会被玩家们调侃，但此刻许元却笑不出来。
如今仔细想来，这些抽象的死法和前世的背后中枪自杀而亡没有任何差别。
并不是意外，这完全是有第三方故意想让他死在这被绑架的路上！
看着外面漆黑阴沉的天际，许元微微攥紧了拳头，长长呼出一口气，看着她平淡的眼神，语气很认真：
“冉先生，我们需要谈谈。”
content_en:
Looking at the burning bonfire, Xu Yuan sighed slightly and chuckled again.
In the past, no matter how complicated the Cangyuan plot was, it was still just a game, and it was impossible to show all aspects of a complete world.
In this extraordinary world, a lot of common sense will become the laughing stock of others.
You don’t necessarily need to take medicine if you get sick here, and you don’t necessarily need a campfire to keep warm if you lose heat in the wild.
Xu Yuan considers himself a very adaptable person, but in the face of this change in the rules of the world, the habits he has developed for more than 20 years will temporarily affect his thinking mode.
With his mind wandering, Xu Yuan glanced at the giant python at the entrance of the cave.
The giant python had been lying there staring at him since he woke up, as if it knew his face.
Without thinking deeply, although the 2.5D pixel wind-shifted first-person real-life perspective made the other party change a lot, Xu Yuan still roughly guessed what species the giant python in front of him was.
Yan Ling Python.
A relatively rare type of elite fire-attribute monster has certain intelligence and can be tamed into a baby and subsequently cultivated into a Yanling Jiao.
In the game, it was very easy to conquer this kind of giant python, just defeat it. It is a kind of monster that is extremely intimidating and afraid of death.
Xu Yuan looked down on such lowly things as babies in the game, but the Yanling Liquid produced by the other party was a good thing, and some of the elixirs refined by using it as an auxiliary medicine were useful even in the later stages.
At present, he is unable to make elixirs, but Yanling Liquid is a kind of heavenly material and earthly treasure that can be used directly.
Recalling the description of Yan Lingye in the formula book, Xu Yuan's eyes flickered slightly.
The I Ching cuts the marrow, removes cold diseases, nourishes yin and strengthens yang. The essence of snake nature has a slight aphrodisiac effect...
Thinking of this, Xu Yuan suddenly remembered that this thing seemed to be one of the formulas for the most precious Hehuan Powder in the evil world line.
He lowered his eyes and glanced at the water bag in his hand, then subconsciously glanced at the other person in the cave.
After Ran Qingmo finished everything he just did, he silently sat cross-legged on the other side of the cave and began to close his eyes and rest. The cold breath could be felt from a long distance away.
Xu Yuan withdrew his gaze and silently put down the water bag.
The Yanling Liquid was indeed a good thing, but in the current situation, he had to drink less, otherwise he would have no place to cry after being chopped up by that big ice lump.
Thinking about these messy things, Xu Yuan patted the wet embroidered robe on his body, stood up and prepared to let the giant python at the entrance of the cave help him dry it.
When clothes get wet, they can be dried quickly without using a fire. In a sense, it is a hundred times more convenient than those dryers in previous lives.
The sound of Xu Yuan walking slowly did not attract Ran Qingmo's attention. She still sat quietly with her eyes closed to relax.
Coming closer and facing Yan Spirit Python's huge vertical pupils, Xu Yuan found that his ability to adapt in some aspects was really strong.
As they looked at each other, Xu Yuan raised his finger and pointed at his clothes.
Yanling Python just lay there and stared at him quietly without moving.
Xu Yuan took a deep breath and pointed at Ran Qingmo next to him.
There was a hint of human disdain in the Yanling python's vertical pupils, and then he opened his mouth carefully and stuck out Snake Xin's mouth.
As soon as the snake letter came out, a dry and burning feeling immediately spread over the face, and the water vapor on the robe evaporated at a speed visible to the naked eye.
Xu Yuan was dumbfounded. It seemed that these monsters also used the trick of pretending to be powerful.
The Yanling Python dries very quickly, but just when Xu Yuan's robe was about to be completely dried,
Something unexpected happened!
A trace of crazy murderous intent suddenly flashed through the huge vertical pupils of Yan Spirit Python, which was originally docile and timid. The snake letter it spat out suddenly turned into an afterimage mixed with the heat wave on the pavement and hit Xu Yuan's head! !
Once such a behemoth's attack hits, there is no room for negotiation if Xu Yuan's head explodes.
This time, Xu Yuan saw it, but ordinary people's bodies could not avoid an attack at such a speed.
The smell of death is like a tideWrapping him up, he could only watch as the snake letter was carried like a hammer
The strong wind hit him on the head.
At the moment of life and death, a blue sword light suddenly cut through the space, and the diffuse heat wave was instantly swallowed up by the endless ice cold.
As soon as his eyes blurred, the black silhouette was blocking his way at a speed invisible to the naked eye.
"Crack-"
With a crisp sound, the slender and thick snake letter was cut off and fell to the cold ground. The remaining nerves made the snake letter keep twisting on the ground.
The cave was quiet for a moment,
"Hiss!!!"jj.br>
With a sharp scream of pain, the Yanling Python's huge body began to struggle continuously, and the cave was shaken by it.
Ran Qingmo, who was standing in front of Xu Yuan, stared calmly at the giant python in front of him with his quiet eyes. He gently pressed his hand on the hilt of the sword and swung the sword casually.
Silently, a slash that penetrated the entire cave appeared on the inner wall of the cave entrance. Through this slash, the gloomy rainy sky outside was clearly visible.
And the Yanling python that was struggling at the entrance of the cave suddenly froze.
Ran Qingmo sheathed his sword and slowly turned to look at Xu Yuan:
"Someone is trying to kill you, we have to go."
There was no blame, no questioning, the abrupt words were just stating a fact she had discovered.
Following the woman's calm voice, the head of the Yanling Python behind her was chopped off in two pieces, and then slipped quietly...
"..."
Xu Yuan looked at the scene in front of him and bit his lip hard.
Without Ran Qingmo's reminder, he had already realized that someone wanted him to die in the mountains.
Monster beasts like the Yanling Python are quite intelligent and have a good nature because they are afraid of death. If they can live for a moment longer, they will never risk their lives to bite back. However, this Yanling python just wanted to risk his life to kill Ran Qingmo in the presence of him.
There can only be some inner fear that makes it necessary to do this.
He suddenly felt a little scared.
If Ran Qingmo had just entered the attack range of the Yanling python when he went out to collect firewood, he might have turned into a corpse by the time she came back.
In the plot of "Cang Yuan", there are nine lines in which the third son of the Xu family died on the way to being kidnapped by Ran Qingmo, and each death method was different.
Because of Ran Qingmo's lack of common sense and negligence, death from hypothermia was just one of them.
He was drowned while drinking water from a creek less than half a meter deep, fell off a cliff, and was hit on the head with a wooden stick...
The various unlucky ways in which the Third Young Master died in various timelines were often ridiculed by players, but Xu Yuan couldn't laugh at this moment.
Now that I think about it carefully, there is no difference between these abstract ways of death and those who committed suicide by being shot in the back in previous lives.
It was not an accident, it was completely a third party who deliberately wanted him to die on the way to being kidnapped!
Looking at the dark and gloomy sky outside, Xu Yuan clenched his fists slightly, exhaled a long breath, looked at her dull eyes, and said in a serious tone:
"Mr. Ran, we need to talk."
